sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo, with aching across forehead. Swim-
ming feeling, as if top of head w’ould float off. Bleed-
ing of nose in clots.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Sore irritable spots along sides of tongue
and throat, gums sore, tongue swollen; aphthous ulcera-
tion. Putrid taste. Furred tongue, large, flabby, in-
dented. Cough with aphonia.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Dark, with albumen and casts. Diffuse
nephritis. Much pain across small of back.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:

ting down. \Fcrr. lod.] Feels as if it opened and
shut. Violent metrorrhagia. Leucorrhoea and backache.
Passive, bearing-down from heavy condition of uterus.
]Vomb is heavy, sodden, with tendency to prolapse.
